description: This file contains implementation of functions for CBOR encoding and digest calculation, including initialization, appending data, finalizing digests, and constructing CBOR structures for access control and additional data.

methods.name: eicCborInit
methods.description: Initializes an EicCbor structure with a buffer and sets default digest type to SHA256.

methods.name: eicCborInitHmacSha256
methods.description: Initializes an EicCbor structure with a buffer and sets digest type to HMAC SHA256 with provided key.

methods.name: eicCborEnableSecondaryDigesterSha256
methods.description: Enables a secondary SHA256 digester for the CBOR object.

methods.name: eicCborFinal
methods.description: Finalizes the digest computation based on the digest type and outputs the digest.

methods.name: eicCborAppend
methods.description: Appends data to the CBOR buffer and updates the digest.

methods.name: eicCborAdditionalLengthBytesFor
methods.description: Calculates the number of additional length bytes needed for a given size.

methods.name: eicCborBegin
methods.description: Starts a CBOR major type with a specified size, encoding the length appropriately.

methods.name: eicCborAppendByteString
methods.description: Appends a byte string to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendString
methods.description: Appends a string to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendStringZ
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendSimple
methods.description: Appends a simple value to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendBool
methods.description: Appends a boolean value to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendSemantic
methods.description: Appends a semantic tag to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendUnsigned
methods.description: Appends an unsigned integer to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendNumber
methods.description: Appends a signed integer to the CBOR buffer.

methods.name: eicCborAppendArray
methods.description: Starts a CBOR array with a specified number of elements.

methods.name: eicCborAppendMap
methods.description: Starts a CBOR map with a specified number of key-value pairs.

methods.name: eicCborCalcAccessControl
methods.description: Constructs a CBOR map representing access control parameters.

methods.name: eicCborCalcEntryAdditionalData
methods.description: Constructs a CBOR structure for additional data, including namespace, name, and access control profile IDs, and computes its SHA256 digest.
